name: Kdenlive
tagline: Non-linear video editor powered by the MLT framework and KDE
description: Kdenlive is an acronym for KDE Non-Linear Video Editor. It is a powerful multi-track video editor that supports almost all audio and video formats via FFmpeg, with keyframe animation, proxy editing, auto-subtitling with Whisper AI, and color grading.
features: Multi-track video editing with timeline audio waveforms
AI Speech-to-Text subtitle generation using Whisper
Color scopes, vectorscope, RGB parade, and LUT support
Configurable keyboard shortcuts and dynamic proxy clips
